title: FIDES-Live: Evaluating Behavioral Concordance in Sequential Trading Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.36476v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sequential trading agents produce decisions, orders, execution receipts, account states, and reports that need not agree, even when the final portfolio value is correctly computed. We present FIDES-Live, an operational extension of FIDES from generated strategy concordance to the audit of sequential agent traces. The protocol separates structured decision validity, optional numerical commitment adherence, execution and ledger reconciliation, and receipt- grounded reporting, with explicit coverage and unscorable outcomes. We retrospectively audit ten requested inference routes over 7,299 cryptocurrency account-rounds and a 310-round equity pilot, using real market observations and local paper execution. Cryptocurrency decision validity is 97.35% and structured reporting accuracy is 90.81% among scorable responses, but route-level decision and reporting performance can diverge sharply. translated_title: FIDES-Live：评估序列交易智能体的行为一致性
translated_abstract: 序列交易智能体会产生决策、订单、执行回执、账户状态和报告，即使最终投资组合价值被正确计算，这些内容也可能彼此不一致。我们提出FIDES-Live，这是FIDES的运营化扩展，将审计范围从生成策略一致性扩展到对序列智能体行为轨迹的审计。该协议将评估划分为结构化决策有效性、可选的数值承诺遵循度、执行与账本对账以及基于回执的报告几个部分，并明确界定了覆盖范围和不可评分的结果。我们对十个被请求的推理路由进行了回顾性审计，涵盖7,299个加密货币账户轮次和一个310轮的股票试点，使用真实市场观测和本地模拟执行。在可评分的响应中，加密货币决策有效性为97.35%，结构化报告准确率为90.81%，但不同路由层面的决策与报告性能可能出现显著分歧。整体承诺遵循度为94.36%；然而它会降至……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出FIDES-Live审计协议，用于检验序列交易智能体的决策、订单、账本与报告之间是否一致，通过对7,299个加密货币账户轮次和310轮股票试点的审计，发现决策有效性达97.35%、报告准确率90.81%、承诺遵循度94.36%，但不同推理路由的表现差异显著。
en_tdlr: FIDES-Live is an audit protocol for evaluating behavioral concordance in sequential trading agents, which retrospectively audits ten inference routes across 7,299 cryptocurrency account-rounds and a 310-round equity pilot, finding 97.35% decision validity, 90.81% structured reporting accuracy, and 94.36% commitment adherence, while revealing sharp performance divergence across routes.
